entry.summary: No visa for visits under 30 days.
entry.max_stay: Under 30 days; longer needs a re-stamp and fee at an immigration office

money-and-cost.cash_card_notes: The local currency is the Belize Dollar (BZD). US dollars are also accepted. You can travel with up to $BZ10,000. You must declare higher amounts. You can only use credit cards and traveller's cheques in large tourist facilities. Before you travel, check with your bank whether your cards will work in Belize.

consular.mission: Australian High Commission, Port of Spain
consular.notes: Australia doesn't have a High Commission or Consulate in Belize. For consular assistance, contact the Australian High Commission in Trinidad and Tobago.

sources.title: Belize travel advice: consular contacts
sources.supports: the Australian offices that give consular help

laws.rule: Penalties for drug offences are severe and include long prison sentences in local jails. In 2017, Belize decriminalised the use of marijuana on private property for adults in possession of up to 10g. However, it remains a federal offence to sell, grow or smoke it on public property. It’s best not to buy or sell marijuana in Belize.
laws.heading: Drugs

laws.rule: Serious crimes, such as treason and murder, can attract the death penalty.
laws.heading: Death penalty

laws.rule: It's illegal to carry pre-Columbian artefacts without a permit. Check with local authorities before taking photos of official buildings. There are strict penalties for possessing unlicensed firearms or unlicensed ammunition, including large fines and mandatory jail sentences for repeat offenders.
laws.heading: Other laws

laws.rule: In Belize, LGBTQIA+ travellers have experienced harassment and verbal or physical abuse. Same-sex relationships were decriminalised in 2016. LGBTQIA+ travellers should carefully consider the risks of travelling to Belize. Consider avoiding public displays of affection.
laws.heading: LGBTQIA+ laws

laws.rule: To drive in Belize, you need an International Driving Permit (IDP). This permit is valid for 3 months. You must get the IDP before arriving in Belize. For longer stays, apply for a local driver's licence from the Belize Department of Transport.
laws.heading: Driving permit
